scope: The regional blend introduces a sharp outer-left-hip notch at 45 degrees that is absent in the raw and full BBW comparison. Full BBW still has abrupt hip creasing at 90 degrees and compressed shoulder/chest shape. No production candidate is approved.

findings.observation: Regional field shows a sharp outer silhouette notch. Full BBW has a continuous outer silhouette here, as does raw.
findings.interpretation: Controlled weight-only evidence implicates the spherical transition for this specific added notch; not a general claim about all deformation.

findings.observation: Full BBW changes a broader thigh area and reduces the prominent upper-thigh protrusion visible in raw/regional, but forms a narrow crease and stretched transition into the groin.
findings.interpretation: Do not promote the complete dense field based on the 45-degree improvement.

findings.observation: Both BBW variants compress the shoulder. Full BBW also changes the breast/chest silhouette noticeably, outside the original regional support.
findings.interpretation: Global adoption requires torso influence control and shoulder-shape review.

findings.observation: Foreground arm obscures much of the joint.
findings.interpretation: These side views cannot independently verify the inner joint contour.

limitations: Static diagnostic snapshots only; no game motion, finger articulation or four-influence runtime qualification.
Pose normals recomputed consistently for all three fields.
No independent anatomical target or anatomical quality metric is available.
No conclusion that source topology or pivot placement is the remaining cause.
next_action: Replace the spherical adoption strategy with an anatomically bounded weight transition that preserves existing hand/finger weights and constrains torso influence. Verify the 45-degree hip notch is removed before sparse fitting; retain the 90-degree hip and shoulder failures as separate gates.
